title: OpenCADStudio self-check versus external CAD audit harness review
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan reconciliation
scope: Inspect the current OpenCADStudio same-codec verified-save harness
Separate its documented Windows reference-CAD AUDIT route from self-readback
Bound both routes for DWG/DXF comparison and 3D support evidence
Preserve required FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification and independent ACIS/AcDs evidence gates

method.kind: Read current project README, automation API, checked-in acceptance script, format-consumer documentation, then reconcile against the local plan
method.limitations: OpenCADStudio sources inspected are current-main documentation/source and were not bound to the v2026.42 release artifact. Its reference_acceptance.ps1 body was not retrieved; its behavior is known from the project README only. No route was executed, so all results remain documentation/source observations rather than qualification receipts.

sources.revision: mutable main pages accessed 2026-10-18; exact v2026.42 tag contents not confirmed
sources.observed: The MCP acceptance script creates a closed polyline, two circles, a line, and text; it requests DWG 2000/2013/2018 and DXF 2000, calls app audit/save_verified, checks verified output/file existence, and captures a viewport PNG plus JSON report. It does not assert an independent per-handle geometry manifest in the script.

sources.revision: API spec 1.1 states applicability to fork builds 2026.41+; accessed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The documented save_verified operation writes the requested version, reopens through the app stack, checks actual version, compares the semantic entity manifest, audits raw DXF handle references, and returns SHA-256. It is a useful same-codec stability/loss check, not an independent reader or expected-value oracle.

sources.revision: mutable main README accessed 2026-10-18; script body not retrieved
sources.observed: The README documents a Windows-only PowerShell route that opens generated DWG 2000/2013/2018 files read-only in isolated command-line console profiles and runs AUDIT without repairs, keeping one log per version. This is a source claim, not an executed pass or 3D semantic test.

FreeCAD documents DWG as external converter to DXF followed by a selected DXF importer, with distinct C++ and optional legacy Python importer routes. The DXF documentation states embedded ACIS/SAT solids are not currently readable by the stock importer.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an optional, composed OpenCADStudio comparison sequence: same-codec verified-save is labeled self-consistency; the Windows reference-console AUDIT route is only structural acceptance when actually run on hash-bound libdxfrw output; source-authored per-handle expectations and separate 3D carrier/owner/geometry gates remain mandatory. This route does not replace the required FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification or independent ACIS/AcDs semantic evidence.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep all peer/native application runs outside the fast per-slice loop.
Before an optional OpenCADStudio run, pin exact app source/release, executable hash, platform, and resolved codec/kernel dependencies.
Feed the exact libdxfrw output bytes into the peer reader; peer-generated output is not an independent writer comparison.
Record output hash, actual file version, load/audit warnings, every dropped/unsupported record, and per-source handle/type/owner disposition.
Treat save_verified and same-codec reopen as internal consistency, not independent semantics.
If the reference CAD console script is used, inspect/pin it and the console, then retain raw audit logs, errors, repairs/deletions, timeout, and process disposition.
Do not infer 3D, ACIS, or AcDs semantics from the four-type 2D acceptance drawing, screenshot, or native AUDIT alone.
Keep FreeCAD Linux and Windows converter/importer/backend qualification separate and required.
For ACIS/AcDs, keep entity shell, section/index/key, owner association, payload bytes, parser losses, independent analytic measures, and native consumer result as separate assertions.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting until their named evidence is independently satisfied.
